svg.title: How ToolBraid turns one human objective into safe, authorized WebMCP execution
svg.desc: ToolBraid discovers nine live tools across six origins, quarantines one hostile tool before scoring, normalizes the remaining contracts into seven canonical capabilities, builds a nine-node dependency graph, runs four safe reads in parallel with a read-only health fallback, prepares recovery and communication, requires two exact human approvals, applies recovery before publishing the customer notice, and seals a 54-entry append-only SHA-256 integrity chain.

g.text: One objective. Nine-node plan. Human-controlled effects.
A browser-native semantic and policy control plane for safe, explainable WebMCP execution.
Find the safest recovery path and
run first; mutation arguments finalize later.
No mutation retry · no mutation fallback
Four independent reads execute concurrently. Only completed evidence can finalize exact mutation arguments.
Two separate exact approvals. Neither is available to the agent.
origin · tool · schema · args · effect · nonce
origin · tool · schema · args · effect · nonce
54 append-only entries · SHA-256 chain verified + sealed
local integrity evidence · not an external signature
